principle: Reuse canonical algorithm engines; UI surfaces are projections and never execution or evidence authority.

experiment_labs.title: ArchWiz Markov Trellis
experiment_labs.model_contract: Transition matrix is the source of truth; strict tree preserves path occurrences; recombining trellis sums incoming path probabilities; particle sampling uses the same transition matrix.

experiment_labs.title: Delphic Graph Observatory
experiment_labs.model_contract: AST containment, dependency DAG, Markov state transitions and temporal lineage remain distinct graph families; refresh is fixture-local.

canonical_components.title: Canonical Kahn DAG planning
canonical_components.role: Deterministic topological order, ready frontiers and cycle-or-blocked residuals. Side-effect-free planning; does not execute work or propagate probabilities.

canonical_components.title: Bayesian routing / uncertainty layer
canonical_components.role: Beta-Bernoulli outcome beliefs, posterior state and value-of-information. Evidence-led uncertainty layer; not a graph layout algorithm.

canonical_components.title: Gantt dependency-phase compiler
canonical_components.role: Compiles filed phases through the canonical Kahn engine into topological stages, dependency waves, critical-path depth and dependency closure.
